children: Applied Digital Corp. reported results for the 2026 period with revenue increasing to $341.88M from $80.93M a year earlier, while the company recorded a net loss and wider diluted loss per share compared with the prior-year period.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Revenue growth was driven by services and other revenue, led by tenant fit-out services and GPU hardware sales.
Applied Digital shifted core focus to high-performance computing (HPC) hosting as Polaris Forge campuses ramped operations and began generating data center rental revenue.
Operational progress included commissioning activity across multiple HPC buildings, with Polaris Forge 1 reaching full 150MW capacity and additional buildings under construction.
The company strengthened partnerships and consolidation efforts, including ChronoScale integration and a strategic collaboration with Microsoft to develop roughly 50MW of AI compute capacity.
Management emphasized energy efficiency and regulatory compliance amid growing scrutiny of AI and crypto hosting operations.
